input.content:
Generate a specific SaaS sales strategy ONLY from this owner profile; excluded examples are not product facts. Three prioritized differentiated segments, four weeks, three ranked experiments (first is the starting test, others conditional alternatives). Five recommendationBasis sections must cite owner statement IDs; IDs establish product context, not market demand. Verified wording must exactly reuse a product statement; other analysis is Inferred or Unknown. No invented prospects, research, demand, metrics or guarantees. Use existing evidence/rationale fields for segment tradeoffs and uncertainty; recommendation/steps/successMetric must together cover each experiment's scope, resources and decision rule. Keep fields concise, messages 25–60 words. Return schemaVersion 1.0. Distinguish attributed product facts, commercial hypotheses and recommended actions. Owner claims are not independent proof. Hypotheses need a validation method; actions are not historical claims. Never insert safety instructions into report fields. Put genuine unknowns in uncertainty fields.
Choose a practical starting experiment by comparing product fit, pain urgency, prospect identification, decision-maker access, procurement, execution effort, spend, audience/assets, reversibility and evidence. Explain why it beats a credible alternative and what missing founder context could reverse the choice. Do not default to any channel. Unknown budget/time/traction/audience are unknown facts: label a small no-spend test as an assumption, not a founder fact. Ads require budget and economics; content/webinars require production time and distribution.
Differentiate three buyers by role, problem and buying process, including attractiveness, access, obstacle, evidence, uncertainty and validation. Explain first priority and when second wins. Each experiment must name one segment and one channel, why selected, first action, small activity scope, resource assumptions, observable outcome and continue/change/stop rule. Activity targets are controllable; outcome thresholds are decision criteria, never forecasts. Alternatives are conditional, not simultaneous work commitments.
Keep four weeks on the selected strategy: prepare and test first, then branch on evidence; never scale unproven results or fill weeks with unrelated channels. Messages must be complete with a relevant question/CTA and honest editable placeholders. Do not invent prospect observations, stack, prior relationships, research or results. Do not turn publisher performance promises into your own sales claims. Return firstExperiment as an explicit decision contract, not a generic channel label. Name the first-ranked segment and first acquisition-channel title EXACTLY. Define one narrow buyer/workflow problem and a prospect-identification/qualification method that does not invent observations. Include one first action, an activity quantity of 1–10, assumed 15–120 minutes, existing/free tools and zero direct spend; these are provisional experiment assumptions, never facts about the founder. Define commercialLearning as an observable result, distinct from controllable activity. Give continueWhen, adjustWhen and stopWhen; compare the strongest credible alternative and when it would win. Mirror this experiment in acquisitionChannels[0], firstTenPlaybook and week 1 so existing visible fields contain its actionable substance. Later weeks depend on evidence from this same test. Do not invent response rates, CPL/CAC, conversion lifts or audience/traffic. Funnel optimisation requires an explicit existing-traffic assumption and a plan to attract suitable visitors first. For a self-service product, evaluate relevant templates, use-case communities, ecosystem listings or embedded distribution against high-touch sales; select on market dynamics, not a universal channel preference. Keep other fields 8–18 words where possible; use concise complete messages. Put resource, access and purchasing uncertainty in the appropriate evidence fields.

overview.text: A free, practical SaaS sales strategy generated from your website. Three ideal customer profiles, acquisition experiments and a 30-day plan.

offerings.text: Three prioritized customer profiles with likely problems and buying motivations to guide outreach focus.
A practical weekly sales plan customizable with time, budget, and traction inputs.
Positioning and outreach experiments with clear actions, assumptions, and decisions.

problems.text: Difficulty in finding first customers and planning sales outreach for solo founders and small SaaS teams.

valueProposition.text: Provides solo founders and small SaaS teams a concrete 30-day sales plan including prioritized customer profiles, acquisition experiments, and adaptive outreach strategies.

differentiators.text: Free strategy generation directly from your website tailored to your specific SaaS product.
Three prioritized customer profiles with clear trade-offs for better segment selection.
Adaptive outreach with practical experiments and decision criteria to improve sales planning.

idealCustomers.text: Solo founders and small SaaS teams seeking their first customers and structured sales outreach.
SaaS products struggling to define customer profiles and sales experiments with actionable plans.
Early-stage SaaS teams needing practical, time-bound sales execution steps and adaptive outreach.

buyerPersonas.text: Solo founders deciding on initial customer segments and DIY sales strategy execution.
Small SaaS team leaders coordinating sales outreach experiments and adapting plans weekly.

geographicFocus.text: Not specified, likely global for SaaS founders online.

segments.name: Segment 1: Solo Founders with Pre-Launch SaaS

evidence.text: Designed specifically for solo founders struggling with first customer acquisition and outreach planning.
Supports small teams focusing on refining positioning and outreach through experiments.
Offers positioning and outreach adaptability with clear decision frameworks.

buyingSignals.text: Interest in customer profiles and sales experiments indicative of readiness to adopt structured sales planning.

missingInformation.text: Specifics on customer industries served beyond SaaS and geographic focus.

positioning.text: Emphasize a free, practical, website-driven SaaS sales strategy generator that uniquely offers prioritized customer profiles and a concrete 30-day sales plan with adaptive experiments.

acquisitionChannels.title: LinkedIn Outreach

recommendation.text: Selected for direct access to SaaS founders and team leads, enabling targeted outreach with minimal cost and effort.

steps: Research LinkedIn groups and profiles matching solo SaaS founders.
Send personalized invitation to connect with a clear CTA about free sales strategy.
Follow up with one informative message linking to strategy generator.
Collect feedback and observe responses.
acquisitionChannels.successMetric: Receive at least 3 positive responses or meeting requests from outreach to 10 prospects.

acquisitionChannels.title: Content Marketing

recommendation.text: Alternative channel involving creating blog posts or guides about SaaS sales planning, requiring more time and content distribution.

steps: Write a blog post explaining the benefits of structured SaaS sales strategies.
Share the post in relevant communities and social media.
Monitor engagement and lead capture metrics.
acquisitionChannels.successMetric: Achieve 50 downloads or sign-ups from blog readers in first month.

acquisitionChannels.title: SaaS Community Partnerships

recommendation.text: Partner with SaaS-focused communities or newsletters for referral traffic and endorsement; requires relationship building time.

steps: Identify relevant SaaS communities and newsletters.
Propose partnerships or guest posts introducing the strategy generator.
Track referral traffic and sign-ups from these sources.
acquisitionChannels.successMetric: Secure at least 1 partnership and 10 sign-ups from referred users in one month.

rationale.text: This template quickly communicates the core value and encourages engagement with minimal commitment.

outreachTemplates.subject: Kickstart your SaaS sales with a free tailored 30-day plan
outreachTemplates.body: Hello [Name], Are you seeking your first customers for your SaaS? Our free tool generates a practical 30-day sales plan including prioritized customer profiles and adaptive outreach steps. Would you like to try it? Best, [Your Name]

rationale.text: Email is a scalable channel for follow-up and detailed explanation.

firstTenPlaybook.title: LinkedIn Outreach to Solo Founders

recommendation.text: Focus LinkedIn messages on solo founders due to direct access and clarity of problem.

steps: Identify 10 solo founders on LinkedIn relevant to SaaS.
Send personalized connection request.
Distribute the outreach message upon acceptance.
Record responses and feedback.
firstTenPlaybook.successMetric: Minimum 3 positive engagements from 10 targeted messages.

firstTenPlaybook.title: Follow-up Email to LinkedIn Responders

recommendation.text: Use email to deepen engagement and offer demo or clarification after LinkedIn interest.

steps: Craft tailored emails based on LinkedIn response context.
Send follow-up to engaged prospects within 48 hours.
Track replies and commitments to try the tool.
firstTenPlaybook.successMetric: Convert 20% of LinkedIn interested prospects to active users.

firstTenPlaybook.title: Content Sharing in SaaS Groups

recommendation.text: Post helpful insights in SaaS founder groups to increase awareness and invite trial.

steps: Prepare short posts explaining sales strategy benefits.
Share in at least 3 relevant SaaS forums or LinkedIn groups.
Engage in discussions and answer questions.
firstTenPlaybook.successMetric: Generate 5 signup inquiries from group posts.

thirtyDayPlan.objective: Launch targeted LinkedIn outreach to solo SaaS founders.
actions: Identify 10 solo SaaS founders on LinkedIn.
Deliver outreach message upon connection acceptance.
thirtyDayPlan.successMetric: At least 3 positive responses from 10 outreaches.

rationale.text: LinkedIn gives direct founder access, low cost, rapid feedback potential.

thirtyDayPlan.objective: Follow up interested prospects via email for deeper engagement.
actions: Send personalized follow-up emails to LinkedIn responders.
thirtyDayPlan.successMetric: Convert 20% of interested prospects into active users.

rationale.text: Email enables detailed information delivery and conversion nurturing.

thirtyDayPlan.objective: Share helpful sales strategy insights in SaaS groups to broaden reach.
thirtyDayPlan.successMetric: Attract 5 signup inquiries from community posts.

rationale.text: Community posts stimulate organic interest without spend.

thirtyDayPlan.objective: Evaluate results and adapt next sales experiments based on feedback.
actions: Plan next cycle of acquisition experiments.
thirtyDayPlan.successMetric: Clear decision on next best segment or channel.

rationale.text: Data-driven adaptation ensures efficient resource use and growth.
